cmd_deploy_desc: Deploy workloads to target mesh node
cmd_scale_desc: Scale service replicas horizontally with automatic load balancing
cmd_rollback_desc: Roll back a workload to its previous stable revision
cmd_status_desc: Display live status of system resources, mesh nodes, and workloads
cmd_dashboard_desc: Launch interactive real-time Charm Bubble Tea TUI dashboard
cmd_logs_desc: Stream real-time logs from a deployed workload
cmd_tunnel_desc: Forward a remote mesh port directly to localhost
cmd_service_desc: Manage the Kizuna background service daemon on this host
cmd_service_run_desc: Run the Kizuna service directly in the foreground
cmd_service_stop_desc: Stop the running Kizuna background service
cmd_service_status_desc: Show the status of the Kizuna background service
cmd_service_install_desc: Install Kizuna as an auto-starting system background service
cmd_service_uninstall_desc: Uninstall the Kizuna system background service
cmd_node_desc: List, pair, or remove target mesh nodes
cmd_node_list_desc: List all configured and paired mesh nodes
cmd_node_pair_desc: Pair a new node into the secure mesh using a PIN
cmd_node_rm_desc: Remove a node from the mesh configuration
cmd_init_desc: Initialize starter kizuna.yaml with multi-env presets
cmd_backup_desc: Create snapshot of workload data with .gitignore filters
cmd_upgrade_desc: Check and self-upgrade kizuna to latest GitHub release
flag_json_desc: Output pure machine-readable JSON (ideal for AI agents & CI)
flag_help_desc: Display help for kizuna or subcommand
